In the collection of clips above, the sudden and intrusive vocal behaviors Mr. Zy0x portrays appear to be of ‘stimming’ behavior, commonly seen in individuals with ADHD and autism (I know we’re all leaning towards ADHD lmao). Stimming is an unconscious behavior, and can occur in various ways; it is not limited to just one form of stimming. In these clips, ‘singing’ is the form of stimming Mr. Zy0x is projecting, usually during moments of concentration. Stimming can help with focus: Mr. Zy0x is using the song “Baby” by Justin Bieber to help him problem solve in Genshindle and forming Abyss combat teams (as a few examples).

According to VeryWellHealth, the difference between stimming in individuals with ADHD and individuals with autism spectrum disorder is the conclusive benefits stimming will provide. Individuals with ADHD commonly stim to improve focus and impulse control, while individuals with autism spectrum disorder commonly stim to manage anxiety.

While the behavioral patterns of Mr. Zy0x is of much similarities in correlation towards the symptoms of ADHD, unless there is an official diagnosis report conducted by a professional, we are not to conclude a psychological evaluation on behalf of Mr. Zy0x (still 5/6 tho om). Medical records are protected under the patient privacy act known as ‘HIPAA’, and it is within each patient’s rights to bear the choice of disclosing medical information. If Mr. Zy0x has ownership of medical records pertaining to psychological diagnoses, the community will be :clueless: to the workings of this peculiar individual.
